name: Chicken, Basil & Fennel Smash
notes:
An Italian-ish smoosh with fresh basil, Parmesan and fennel. Mob's figures don't include bread for this one.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 3 chicken breasts
• ½ cucumber
• 1 avocado
• 30g fresh basil
• 80g Parmesan
• 2 tbsp full-fat cottage cheese
• 1 tsp fennel seed
• Olive oil

Method:
1. Heat the oven to 180°C. Season the chicken with salt, pepper and a good drizzle of olive oil.
2. Roast on a baking tray for 30 mins until cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, finely dice the cucumber and avocado, finely chop the basil and grate the Parmesan.
4. Chop the cooked chicken into even pieces and combine with everything else in a large bowl.
5. Smoosh over toast, pitta, a bagel or whatever you fancy.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 12g, fibre 8g, sugars 3g, sodium 912mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/chicken-basil-fennel-smoosh
